Class Typeface

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.assets.Typeface
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Typeface extends Object implements Cloneable
Data structure containing metrics and animation data for a typeface to be drawn by the graphics system
